name: Electricity Maps
description: How much CO₂ the electricity in your country causes right now
comment: v3 carbon-intensity/latest with the auth-token header, from the client library that Home Assistant uses; the official documentation refuses automated reading. api.electricitymaps.com answers without a redirect. The free key is for personal, non-commercial use; Home Assistant gives its limit as 50 requests an hour (unverified at the source), so it refreshes every 15 minutes.
